answer: Make every agent earn identity through a long voyage. First, it registers at one vertex: one hardware-attested device, one payment card, one phone number, and that vertex may sponsor only five agents. Second, it crosses the tundra of seven independent checkpoints over 21 days, each checking a different proof: work samples, a hardware signature, and a peer vouch. Third, any failed check freezes the voyage for 30 days. Forging 10,000 agents needs 2,000 devices, $250,000 in fees, and 210,000 checkpoint passes. A sybil army, like footprints in snow, melts under inspection.
